# names: every name KnownNames gives, and Describe of it
YAKU_ABUSE_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between abuse-monitor checks (default 60)
YAKU_ABUSE_SOURCE	Abuse monitor reads: counters (default with Redis), records or compare
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR	Health/admin port of a role: /healthz, /readyz, /status; unset = none
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_ABUSE_MONITOR	Admin/health port of the abuse-monitor role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_BACKUP	Admin/health port of the backup role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_BILLING	Admin/health port of the billing role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_BLACKHOLE	Admin/health port of the blackhole role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_DB_WORKER	Admin/health port of the db-worker role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_DLR	Admin/health port of the dlr role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_EXPIRY	Admin/health port of the expiry role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_HTTP_SERVER	Admin/health port of the http-server role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_HTTP_VENDOR	Admin/health port of the http-vendor role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_MO	Admin/health port of the mo role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_RETENTION	Admin/health port of the retention role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_RETRY	Admin/health port of the retry role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_SMPP_SERVER	Admin/health port of the smpp-server role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR_SMPP_VENDOR	Admin/health port of the smpp-vendor role only (beats YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR)
YAKU_ADMIN_KEY	Key for /admin/* calls and the control port; unset = /admin off
YAKU_ADMIN_PASSWORD	Password for /admin/* calls (with YAKU_ADMIN_USER)
YAKU_ADMIN_USER	User name for /admin/* calls (with YAKU_ADMIN_PASSWORD)
YAKU_API_ADDR	Submit API port for clients (default :8080)
YAKU_API_TLS	off = no HTTPS port even when the certificate is set
YAKU_API_TLS_ADDR	HTTPS port for the submit API; needs the certificate and key too
YAKU_API_TLS_CERT	Certificate file for the HTTPS port
YAKU_API_TLS_CLIENT_CA	CA bundle; set = HTTPS clients must show a certificate
YAKU_API_TLS_KEY	Private key file for the HTTPS port
YAKU_AUTO_MIGRATE	Create and upgrade the databases at start (default on)
YAKU_AUTO_SEED	Add demo rows on first start (default off; dev boxes only)
YAKU_BACKUP_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between backups (default 86400, once a day)
YAKU_BACKUP_KEEP	Complete backups kept (default 7)
YAKU_BACKUP_ROOT	Folder for backups (default ./backups)
YAKU_BALANCE_REPLY_CACHE_MS	Ms a reply's balance read from MySQL is reused (2000; 0 = never)
YAKU_BASE_CURRENCY	System base currency prices are compared in (USD)
YAKU_BILLING_BATCH	Records priced per billing pass (default 1000)
YAKU_BILLING_DRAIN_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_BILLING_FULL_PASS_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_BILLING_HOT_DAYS	Days of record tables the billing role reads on every sweep (3)
YAKU_BILLING_INTERVAL_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_BILLING_MAX_RATING_ATTEMPTS	Failed pricing tries before a record is set aside (5)
YAKU_BLACKHOLE_BATCH	Messages the test vendor takes per pass (default 500)
YAKU_CACHE_REFRESH_SEC	Seconds between checks for changed settings (default 30)
YAKU_CAPTURE_MAX_RECORDS	Records the portal keeps per flow capture (20000)
YAKU_COLD_BACKEND	Where old records are archived (mysql)
YAKU_COLD_DSN	Connection string for the archive database
YAKU_COLD_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the archive database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_CONCAT_ASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT_SEC	Seconds to wait for all parts of a long message (60)
YAKU_CONCAT_MO_STORE	Where incoming (MO) long-message parts wait: mysql, redis, memory
YAKU_CONCAT_MT_STORE	Where a client's long-message parts wait: mysql, redis, memory
YAKU_CONCAT_STALE_HOURS	Hours to keep part receipts that never all came (48)
YAKU_CONFIG_BACKEND	Settings database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_CONFIG_DSN	Connection string for the settings database
YAKU_CONFIG_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the settings database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_CONSOLE_MENUS	Console menus: cursor (arrow keys) or numbers
YAKU_CONTROL_ADDR	Local port the console uses to start/stop roles (127.0.0.1:8099)
YAKU_CORS_ORIGINS	Web sites allowed to call the API from a browser, comma list
YAKU_CRYPTO_AT_REST	on = encrypt message text in new records
YAKU_CRYPTO_FIELDS	Which fields are encrypted, comma list (default body)
YAKU_CRYPTO_KEK_REF	Where the gateway's master key is kept (file:// or env://)
YAKU_DB_IDLE_SEC	Seconds before an unused MySQL connection is closed (300)
YAKU_DB_INTERPOLATE	Values put into a statement by the driver: 1 round trip, not 3 (on)
YAKU_DB_MAX_IDLE	Unused MySQL connections a role keeps ready per database (8 or 4)
YAKU_DB_MAX_OPEN	Most MySQL connections one role keeps per database (16 or 8)
YAKU_DB_QUEUE_LANES	Lists the billing events are spread over, 1 to 64 (4)
YAKU_DEDUPE_TTL_SEC	Seconds a message is remembered to catch duplicates (1800)
YAKU_DEFAULT_TTL_SEC	How long a message may wait to be sent, seconds (48 h)
YAKU_DEPLOYMENT_ID	This gateway's name (e.g. lhr-1); set = it keeps its own queues
YAKU_DLR_ADDR	Port where vendors post delivery receipts (default :8090)
YAKU_DLR_CORRELATE_GRACE_MS	Wait before a receipt is called unmatched, ms (250)
YAKU_ENV	Label shown on monitoring, e.g. production or staging
YAKU_FX_TIMEOUT_MS	Longest one call to a currency rate provider may take, ms (3000)
YAKU_GLOBAL_TPS	Gateway-wide limit, message parts per second; 0 = none
YAKU_HEALTH_ADDR	Health-only port (/healthz, /readyz) of a role; unset = none
YAKU_HLR_BACKEND	HLR database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_HLR_CALL_LOG	Live lookups keeping the provider's raw call: all, failed, off (all)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_MCC_FIELD	Field in the lookup answer holding the country code (mcc)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_MNC_FIELD	Field in the lookup answer holding the network code (mnc)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_OK_FIELD	Field that must be true for a lookup to count; optional
YAKU_HLR_DIP_PORTED_FIELD	Field saying the number moved network; optional
YAKU_HLR_DIP_TIMEOUT_MS	Longest wait for one live lookup, ms (default 300)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_URL	Live number-lookup URL with {msisdn}; unset = data only
YAKU_HLR_DSN	HLR data, vendor sessions; unset = the queue database
YAKU_HLR_MAX_INFLIGHT	Most live lookups at once (default 64)
YAKU_HLR_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the HLR database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_HOT_BACKEND	Record database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_HOT_DAYS	Days of records kept before archiving, unless a company sets its own
YAKU_HOT_DSN	Connection string for the recent-records database
YAKU_HOT_MONTHS	Retired: read as days (x 30) while YAKU_HOT_DAYS is unset
YAKU_HOT_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the record database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_HTTP_IDLE_PER_HOST	Idle connections kept per host for vendor calls and webhooks (512)
YAKU_INBOUND_FAIL_THRESHOLD	Failed vendor logins before that vendor door locks (5)
YAKU_INBOUND_IP_THRESHOLD	Failed vendor logins from one IP before it is slowed (20)
YAKU_KMS_GCP_CREDENTIALS_REF	Where the Google service-account JSON is kept
YAKU_KMS_GCP_ENABLED	on = companies may use their own Google Cloud KMS key
YAKU_LEDGER_PER_MESSAGE	1 = still write a ledger row per message (only during an upgrade)
YAKU_LOG_DIR	Folder for log files (default /var/log/yakugate)
YAKU_LOG_LEVEL	Log level: debug, info, warn, error or none (info)
YAKU_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB	Start a new log file past this size, MB; 0 = none (100)
YAKU_LOG_REDACT	Hide phone numbers and codes in logs; off = show (on)
YAKU_LOG_REJECTS	off = do not record refused submits
YAKU_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS	Delete log files older than this, days; 0 = keep (30)
YAKU_LOSS_NO_RATE	Loss check when no exchange rate is known: refuse (default) or accept
YAKU_MASK_MIN_DIGITS	Shortest digit run hidden when text is masked (default 4)
YAKU_MAX_ATTEMPTS	Send tries per message before it fails (default 5)
YAKU_MAX_BATCH	Most items in a personalised messages[] list (default 500)
YAKU_MAX_RECIPIENTS	Most recipients in one submit request (default 500)
YAKU_MAX_SEGMENTS	Most parts in one long message; longer is refused (default 10)
YAKU_MIGRATE_SKIP_TRIGGERS	MySQL: skip triggers this login may not create (no audit hash chain)
YAKU_MONITOR_CPU_PCT	Event when host CPU goes over this % (90)
YAKU_MONITOR_EVENTS	Monitoring events on or off (on)
YAKU_MONITOR_HISTORY	off = do not save monitoring history
YAKU_MONITOR_HOLD	Intervals a condition must last to start or end an event (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_LATENCY_MS	Event when acceptance p95 goes over this, in ms (50)
YAKU_MONITOR_MEM_PCT	Event when host memory goes over this % (90)
YAKU_MONITOR_MYSQL_CONN_PCT	MySQL connections over this % of max_connections is a warning (80)
YAKU_MONITOR_QUEUE_AGE_SEC	Event when a queue's oldest ready message waits longer (300)
YAKU_MONITOR_QUEUE_DEPTH	Event when more messages wait in one queue than this (10000)
YAKU_MONITOR_REDIS_MEM_PCT	Redis memory over this % of maxmemory is a warning (80)
YAKU_MONITOR_REJECT_MIN_TPS	Refusal share judged only at this many messages/s (1)
YAKU_MONITOR_REJECT_PCT	Event when refused share of incoming goes over this % (20)
YAKU_MONITOR_REPLICA_LAG_SEC	A MySQL replica further behind than this, in seconds, is a warning (30)
YAKU_MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS	Days every 5-second report is kept; 0 = all (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_SPIKE_FACTOR	Event when incoming is this many times its usual level (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_STORE_PING_MS	A MySQL or Redis round trip slower than this is a warning (100)
YAKU_MONITOR_SUMMARY_DAYS	Days monitoring day summaries and events are kept (10)
YAKU_MONITOR_TRAFFIC_MIN_TPS	Traffic stop/spike judged above this messages/s (1)
YAKU_MO_ADDR	Port where vendors post incoming messages (default :8091)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_LIMIT	Unmatched receipts retried per pass (default 200)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_MAX_SEC	Longest wait between tries of a receipt that matches nothing (300)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_MINUTES	How far back unmatched receipts are retried, minutes (60)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_SEC	Seconds between retries of unmatched receipts; 0 = off (5)
YAKU_PCAP_DIR	Folder for packet captures (default <log dir>/pcap)
YAKU_PCAP_INTERFACE	Network interface tcpdump listens on (default any)
YAKU_PCAP_MAX_MB	Stop a packet capture at this size, MB; 0 = none (256)
YAKU_PCAP_TCPDUMP	tcpdump program name or full path (default tcpdump)
YAKU_PUSH_BASE_DELAY_SEC	First wait before trying a client URL again, s (60)
YAKU_PUSH_GIVE_UP_AFTER_SEC	Give up on a client URL after this many seconds (86400)
YAKU_PUSH_MAX_ATTEMPTS	Tries to deliver a receipt/incoming to a client URL (30)
YAKU_PUSH_MAX_DELAY_SEC	Longest wait between tries, seconds (default 3600)
YAKU_PUSH_MULTIPLIER	Each wait is this many times the last (default 2)
YAKU_QUALITY_MIN_SAMPLE	Results a vendor needs before it is judged (default 20)
YAKU_QUALITY_WINDOW_MIN	Minutes of results used to judge a vendor (default 60)
YAKU_QUEUE_BACKEND	Where queues run: mysql (default), mssql, or redis (Redis only)
YAKU_QUEUE_BILLING_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the billing queue lanes, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_BILLING_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the billing queue lanes takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_DLR_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the receipts for clients, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_DLR_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the receipts for clients takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_DSN	The queue database (with YAKU_QUEUE_BACKEND=mysql or mssql)
YAKU_QUEUE_EXPIRY_EVERY_MS	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the expiry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_EXPIRY_PER_INTERVAL	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the expiry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_HANDOFF_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the hand-off lists, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_HANDOFF_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the hand-off lists takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MO_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the MO for clients, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MO_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the MO for clients takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MT_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the vendor queues, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MT_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the vendor queues takes (2000)
YAKU_QUEUE_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the queue database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_QUEUE_RECEIPT_WRITES_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the receipt rows (rcptw), busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECEIPT_WRITES_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the receipt rows (rcptw) takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECORDS_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the record queue lanes, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECORDS_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the record queue lanes takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_ADDR	The queues' own Redis, host:port; unset = the main Redis
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_DB	Database number on the queues' own Redis (default 0)
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_FAILOVER_ADDR	Standby for the queues' own Redis, host:port
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_MASTER_NAME	Name those Sentinels monitor the queues' Redis by
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_PASSWORD	Password of the queues' own Redis
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_SENTINEL_ADDRS	Sentinels of the queues' own Redis, host:port list
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD	Password of the queue Redis's Sentinels, if any
YAKU_QUEUE_REROUTE_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the re-route inbox, busy or idle (2000)
YAKU_QUEUE_REROUTE_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the re-route inbox takes (200)
YAKU_QUEUE_RETRY_EVERY_MS	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the retry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_RETRY_PER_INTERVAL	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the retry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_RATE_HISTORY_HOURS	Hours back a message is priced by its accept-time rates (72; 0=off)
YAKU_RECEIPTS_IN_REDIS	Receipts use Redis, MySQL written after in batches (on; 0 = off)
YAKU_RECORDS_VIA	worker (default with Redis): the DB worker writes the records; direct
YAKU_RECORD_LANES	Lists the record queue is spread over; a message keeps to one (4)
YAKU_RECORD_QUEUE_MAX	Most records that may wait for the DB worker (2000000)
YAKU_REDIS_ADDR	Redis host:port; set = queues and counters run in Redis
YAKU_REDIS_BALANCE_TIMEOUT_MS	Wait for Redis in a balance deduction (connection + answer), ms (30000)
YAKU_REDIS_DB	Redis database number (default 0)
YAKU_REDIS_FAILOVER_ADDR	Standby Redis host:port, used when the main one fails
YAKU_REDIS_MASTER_NAME	Name the Sentinels know the main Redis by (often mymaster)
YAKU_REDIS_PASSWORD	Password for Redis
YAKU_REDIS_POOL_SIZE	Connections one Redis client keeps (default 10 a CPU)
YAKU_REDIS_POOL_TIMEOUT_MS	Wait for a free Redis connection before failing, ms (4000)
YAKU_REDIS_SENTINEL_ADDRS	Sentinels as host:port,host:port; set = Sentinel finds the main Redis
YAKU_REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD	Password for the Sentinels themselves, when they have one
YAKU_REDIS_SYNC_SEC	Seconds between copying settings from MySQL to Redis (default 30)
YAKU_REDIS_WATCH_SEC	Seconds between checks for new settings in Redis (default 3)
YAKU_REROUTE	off = do not move messages off a vendor that is down
YAKU_RETENTION_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between archiving passes (default 3600)
YAKU_RETENTION_SKIP_CHECKSUM	true = archive on row count alone when checksum fails
YAKU_ROLES	Roles the whole gateway runs, comma list; empty = all
YAKU_SENDER_MAX_ALPHA	Longest letter sender ID (default 11)
YAKU_SENDER_MAX_NUMERIC	Longest number sender ID (default 15)
YAKU_SMPP_ADDR	SMPP port for clients (default :2775); off = no plain port, TLS only
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_BATCH	Receipts/incoming taken per pass for SMPP clients (200)
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_MS	Retired: read for receipts and MO while YAKU_QUEUE_DLR/MO_* are unset
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_WINDOW	Receipts and MO one client bind may have unanswered (64)
YAKU_SMPP_DRAIN_SEC	Seconds a vendor bind waits for answers when stopping (5)
YAKU_SMPP_MAX_CONNS	Most client SMPP connections at once; 0 = no limit (2000)
YAKU_SMPP_SERVER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT	Submits smpp-server works on at once; off = no limit (25 a connection)
YAKU_SMPP_SERVER_OVER_LIMIT	Over that limit: hold (wait their turn) or throttle (0x58) (hold)
YAKU_SMPP_THROTTLE_PAUSE_SEC	Pause after a vendor says throttled, when its own is unset (1)
YAKU_SMPP_TLS	off = no SMPP-over-TLS port even when the certificate is set
YAKU_SMPP_TLS_ADDR	SMPP-over-TLS port for clients; unset = none
YAKU_SMPP_TLS_CERT	Certificate file for the SMPP-over-TLS port
YAKU_SMPP_TLS_CLIENT_CA	CA bundle; set = SMPP-TLS clients must show a certificate
YAKU_SMPP_TLS_KEY	Private key file for the SMPP-over-TLS port
YAKU_SMPP_VENDOR_INBOUND_WORKERS	Workers per vendor bind for receipts and incoming (4)
YAKU_SMPP_WINDOW	Messages one client bind may have in flight (default 16)
YAKU_SMPP_WINDOW_GRACE_MS	Wait for a free window slot before refusing, ms (200)
YAKU_SPRAY_DISTINCT_THRESHOLD	Different logins one IP may try before it is blocked (3)
YAKU_STATUS_KEY	Key for the read-only /status page; unset = /status off
YAKU_STATUS_PUSH_SEC	Seconds between monitoring snapshots (default 5)
YAKU_SUPERVISED	Set by the gateway on the roles it starts; not a file setting
YAKU_TOKEN_PEPPER	Secret mixed into stored token digests; keep it secret
YAKU_TRUSTED_PROXIES	Your own proxies (IPs/CIDRs) whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted
YAKU_VENDOR_CALL_LOG	HTTP vendor answers keeping their raw call: all, failed, off (all)
YAKU_VENDOR_RELOAD_SEC	Seconds between re-reading vendor settings (default 30)
YAKU_VERSION	Build label shown on monitoring
YAKU_WEBHOOK_CALL_LOG	Webhook tries keeping their request and answer: all, failed, off (all)
YAKU_WEBHOOK_RELOAD_SEC	Seconds between checks for changed customer webhooks (3)
YAKU_WORKER_CHARGES	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it

# groups: describe's lines in their groups
[Stores]
YAKU_CONFIG_BACKEND	Settings database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_CONFIG_DSN	Connection string for the settings database
YAKU_CONFIG_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the settings database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_QUEUE_BACKEND	Where queues run: mysql (default), mssql, or redis (Redis only)
YAKU_QUEUE_DSN	The queue database (with YAKU_QUEUE_BACKEND=mysql or mssql)
YAKU_QUEUE_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the queue database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_HLR_BACKEND	HLR database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_ADDR	The queues' own Redis, host:port; unset = the main Redis
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_PASSWORD	Password of the queues' own Redis
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_DB	Database number on the queues' own Redis (default 0)
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_FAILOVER_ADDR	Standby for the queues' own Redis, host:port
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_SENTINEL_ADDRS	Sentinels of the queues' own Redis, host:port list
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_MASTER_NAME	Name those Sentinels monitor the queues' Redis by
YAKU_QUEUE_REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD	Password of the queue Redis's Sentinels, if any
YAKU_HLR_DSN	HLR data, vendor sessions; unset = the queue database
YAKU_HLR_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the HLR database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_HOT_BACKEND	Record database type: mysql or mssql (unset = from its DSN)
YAKU_HOT_DSN	Connection string for the recent-records database
YAKU_HOT_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the record database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_COLD_BACKEND	Where old records are archived (mysql)
YAKU_COLD_DSN	Connection string for the archive database
YAKU_COLD_READ_DSN	Read DSN of the archive database; unset = read where it is written
YAKU_AUTO_MIGRATE	Create and upgrade the databases at start (default on)
YAKU_AUTO_SEED	Add demo rows on first start (default off; dev boxes only)
YAKU_MIGRATE_SKIP_TRIGGERS	MySQL: skip triggers this login may not create (no audit hash chain)
YAKU_REDIS_ADDR	Redis host:port; set = queues and counters run in Redis
YAKU_REDIS_FAILOVER_ADDR	Standby Redis host:port, used when the main one fails
YAKU_REDIS_SENTINEL_ADDRS	Sentinels as host:port,host:port; set = Sentinel finds the main Redis
YAKU_REDIS_MASTER_NAME	Name the Sentinels know the main Redis by (often mymaster)
YAKU_REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD	Password for the Sentinels themselves, when they have one
YAKU_REDIS_PASSWORD	Password for Redis
YAKU_REDIS_DB	Redis database number (default 0)
YAKU_REDIS_POOL_SIZE	Connections one Redis client keeps (default 10 a CPU)
YAKU_REDIS_POOL_TIMEOUT_MS	Wait for a free Redis connection before failing, ms (4000)
YAKU_REDIS_BALANCE_TIMEOUT_MS	Wait for Redis in a balance deduction (connection + answer), ms (30000)
YAKU_REDIS_SYNC_SEC	Seconds between copying settings from MySQL to Redis (default 30)
YAKU_REDIS_WATCH_SEC	Seconds between checks for new settings in Redis (default 3)
[Whole gateway and roles]
YAKU_ROLES	Roles the whole gateway runs, comma list; empty = all
YAKU_CONTROL_ADDR	Local port the console uses to start/stop roles (127.0.0.1:8099)
YAKU_DEPLOYMENT_ID	This gateway's name (e.g. lhr-1); set = it keeps its own queues
YAKU_DB_MAX_OPEN	Most MySQL connections one role keeps per database (16 or 8)
YAKU_DB_MAX_IDLE	Unused MySQL connections a role keeps ready per database (8 or 4)
YAKU_DB_IDLE_SEC	Seconds before an unused MySQL connection is closed (300)
YAKU_DB_INTERPOLATE	Values put into a statement by the driver: 1 round trip, not 3 (on)
YAKU_RECORDS_VIA	worker (default with Redis): the DB worker writes the records; direct
YAKU_WORKER_CHARGES	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_DB_QUEUE_LANES	Lists the billing events are spread over, 1 to 64 (4)
YAKU_QUEUE_MT_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the vendor queues, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MT_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the vendor queues takes (2000)
YAKU_QUEUE_DLR_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the receipts for clients, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_DLR_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the receipts for clients takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MO_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the MO for clients, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_MO_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the MO for clients takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECORDS_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the record queue lanes, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECORDS_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the record queue lanes takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_BILLING_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the billing queue lanes, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_BILLING_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the billing queue lanes takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECEIPT_WRITES_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the receipt rows (rcptw), busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_RECEIPT_WRITES_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the receipt rows (rcptw) takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_HANDOFF_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the hand-off lists, busy or idle (1000)
YAKU_QUEUE_HANDOFF_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the hand-off lists takes (5000)
YAKU_QUEUE_REROUTE_EVERY_MS	Ms between checks of the re-route inbox, busy or idle (2000)
YAKU_QUEUE_REROUTE_PER_INTERVAL	Most items one check of the re-route inbox takes (200)
YAKU_QUEUE_RETRY_EVERY_MS	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the retry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_RETRY_PER_INTERVAL	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the retry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_EXPIRY_EVERY_MS	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the expiry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_QUEUE_EXPIRY_PER_INTERVAL	Retired 27 Oct 2026 with the expiry role: nothing reads it
YAKU_RECORD_LANES	Lists the record queue is spread over; a message keeps to one (4)
YAKU_RECORD_QUEUE_MAX	Most records that may wait for the DB worker (2000000)
YAKU_ENV	Label shown on monitoring, e.g. production or staging
YAKU_VERSION	Build label shown on monitoring
YAKU_SUPERVISED	Set by the gateway on the roles it starts; not a file setting
YAKU_CONSOLE_MENUS	Console menus: cursor (arrow keys) or numbers
YAKU_CACHE_REFRESH_SEC	Seconds between checks for changed settings (default 30)
YAKU_WEBHOOK_RELOAD_SEC	Seconds between checks for changed customer webhooks (3)
YAKU_BALANCE_REPLY_CACHE_MS	Ms a reply's balance read from MySQL is reused (2000; 0 = never)
[Listeners]
YAKU_API_ADDR	Submit API port for clients (default :8080)
YAKU_SMPP_ADDR	SMPP port for clients (default :2775); off = no plain port, TLS only
YAKU_DLR_ADDR	Port where vendors post delivery receipts (default :8090)
YAKU_MO_ADDR	Port where vendors post incoming messages (default :8091)
YAKU_ADMIN_ADDR	Health/admin port of a role: /healthz, /readyz, /status; unset = none
YAKU_HEALTH_ADDR	Health-only port (/healthz, /readyz) of a role; unset = none
YAKU_HTTP_IDLE_PER_HOST	Idle connections kept per host for vendor calls and webhooks (512)
YAKU_CORS_ORIGINS	Web sites allowed to call the API from a browser, comma list
YAKU_TRUSTED_PROXIES	Your own proxies (IPs/CIDRs) whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted
[TLS]
YAKU_API_TLS	off = no HTTPS port even when the certificate is set
YAKU_API_TLS_ADDR	HTTPS port for the submit API; needs the certificate and key too
YAKU_API_TLS_CERT	Certificate file for the HTTPS port
YAKU_API_TLS_KEY	Private key file for the HTTPS port
YAKU_API_TLS_CLIENT_CA	CA bundle; set = HTTPS clients must show a certificate
YAKU_SMPP_TLS	off = no SMPP-over-TLS port even when the certificate is set

YAKU_SMPP_TLS_CLIENT_CA	CA bundle; set = SMPP-TLS clients must show a certificate
[Keys and secrets]
YAKU_ADMIN_KEY	Key for /admin/* calls and the control port; unset = /admin off
YAKU_ADMIN_USER	User name for /admin/* calls (with YAKU_ADMIN_PASSWORD)
YAKU_ADMIN_PASSWORD	Password for /admin/* calls (with YAKU_ADMIN_USER)
YAKU_STATUS_KEY	Key for the read-only /status page; unset = /status off
YAKU_TOKEN_PEPPER	Secret mixed into stored token digests; keep it secret
YAKU_CRYPTO_AT_REST	on = encrypt message text in new records
YAKU_CRYPTO_FIELDS	Which fields are encrypted, comma list (default body)
YAKU_CRYPTO_KEK_REF	Where the gateway's master key is kept (file:// or env://)
YAKU_KMS_GCP_ENABLED	on = companies may use their own Google Cloud KMS key
YAKU_KMS_GCP_CREDENTIALS_REF	Where the Google service-account JSON is kept
[Accepting messages]
YAKU_MAX_RECIPIENTS	Most recipients in one submit request (default 500)
YAKU_MAX_BATCH	Most items in a personalised messages[] list (default 500)
YAKU_MAX_SEGMENTS	Most parts in one long message; longer is refused (default 10)
YAKU_SENDER_MAX_ALPHA	Longest letter sender ID (default 11)
YAKU_SENDER_MAX_NUMERIC	Longest number sender ID (default 15)
YAKU_GLOBAL_TPS	Gateway-wide limit, message parts per second; 0 = none
YAKU_DEDUPE_TTL_SEC	Seconds a message is remembered to catch duplicates (1800)
YAKU_DEFAULT_TTL_SEC	How long a message may wait to be sent, seconds (48 h)
YAKU_SPRAY_DISTINCT_THRESHOLD	Different logins one IP may try before it is blocked (3)
YAKU_LOG_REJECTS	off = do not record refused submits
YAKU_REROUTE	off = do not move messages off a vendor that is down
YAKU_MASK_MIN_DIGITS	Shortest digit run hidden when text is masked (default 4)
[HLR]
YAKU_HLR_DIP_URL	Live number-lookup URL with {msisdn}; unset = data only
YAKU_HLR_DIP_TIMEOUT_MS	Longest wait for one live lookup, ms (default 300)
YAKU_HLR_CALL_LOG	Live lookups keeping the provider's raw call: all, failed, off (all)
YAKU_HLR_MAX_INFLIGHT	Most live lookups at once (default 64)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_MCC_FIELD	Field in the lookup answer holding the country code (mcc)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_MNC_FIELD	Field in the lookup answer holding the network code (mnc)
YAKU_HLR_DIP_OK_FIELD	Field that must be true for a lookup to count; optional
YAKU_HLR_DIP_PORTED_FIELD	Field saying the number moved network; optional
[SMPP]
YAKU_SMPP_MAX_CONNS	Most client SMPP connections at once; 0 = no limit (2000)
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_WINDOW	Receipts and MO one client bind may have unanswered (64)
YAKU_SMPP_WINDOW	Messages one client bind may have in flight (default 16)
YAKU_SMPP_WINDOW_GRACE_MS	Wait for a free window slot before refusing, ms (200)
YAKU_SMPP_SERVER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT	Submits smpp-server works on at once; off = no limit (25 a connection)
YAKU_SMPP_SERVER_OVER_LIMIT	Over that limit: hold (wait their turn) or throttle (0x58) (hold)
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_BATCH	Receipts/incoming taken per pass for SMPP clients (200)
YAKU_SMPP_DELIVER_MS	Retired: read for receipts and MO while YAKU_QUEUE_DLR/MO_* are unset
YAKU_SMPP_DRAIN_SEC	Seconds a vendor bind waits for answers when stopping (5)
YAKU_SMPP_THROTTLE_PAUSE_SEC	Pause after a vendor says throttled, when its own is unset (1)
YAKU_SMPP_VENDOR_INBOUND_WORKERS	Workers per vendor bind for receipts and incoming (4)
YAKU_RECEIPTS_IN_REDIS	Receipts use Redis, MySQL written after in batches (on; 0 = off)
YAKU_VENDOR_RELOAD_SEC	Seconds between re-reading vendor settings (default 30)
YAKU_VENDOR_CALL_LOG	HTTP vendor answers keeping their raw call: all, failed, off (all)
YAKU_CONCAT_ASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT_SEC	Seconds to wait for all parts of a long message (60)
YAKU_CONCAT_MO_STORE	Where incoming (MO) long-message parts wait: mysql, redis, memory
YAKU_CONCAT_MT_STORE	Where a client's long-message parts wait: mysql, redis, memory
YAKU_CONCAT_STALE_HOURS	Hours to keep part receipts that never all came (48)
YAKU_BLACKHOLE_BATCH	Messages the test vendor takes per pass (default 500)
[Receipts and incoming]
YAKU_DLR_CORRELATE_GRACE_MS	Wait before a receipt is called unmatched, ms (250)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_SEC	Seconds between retries of unmatched receipts; 0 = off (5)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_MAX_SEC	Longest wait between tries of a receipt that matches nothing (300)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_MINUTES	How far back unmatched receipts are retried, minutes (60)
YAKU_ORPHAN_REMATCH_LIMIT	Unmatched receipts retried per pass (default 200)
YAKU_INBOUND_FAIL_THRESHOLD	Failed vendor logins before that vendor door locks (5)
YAKU_INBOUND_IP_THRESHOLD	Failed vendor logins from one IP before it is slowed (20)
YAKU_PUSH_MAX_ATTEMPTS	Tries to deliver a receipt/incoming to a client URL (30)
YAKU_PUSH_BASE_DELAY_SEC	First wait before trying a client URL again, s (60)
YAKU_PUSH_MULTIPLIER	Each wait is this many times the last (default 2)
YAKU_PUSH_MAX_DELAY_SEC	Longest wait between tries, seconds (default 3600)
YAKU_PUSH_GIVE_UP_AFTER_SEC	Give up on a client URL after this many seconds (86400)
YAKU_WEBHOOK_CALL_LOG	Webhook tries keeping their request and answer: all, failed, off (all)
[Retry and quality]
YAKU_MAX_ATTEMPTS	Send tries per message before it fails (default 5)
YAKU_QUALITY_WINDOW_MIN	Minutes of results used to judge a vendor (default 60)
YAKU_QUALITY_MIN_SAMPLE	Results a vendor needs before it is judged (default 20)
[Billing and abuse]
YAKU_BILLING_INTERVAL_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_BILLING_BATCH	Records priced per billing pass (default 1000)
YAKU_BILLING_DRAIN_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_BILLING_MAX_RATING_ATTEMPTS	Failed pricing tries before a record is set aside (5)
YAKU_BILLING_HOT_DAYS	Days of record tables the billing role reads on every sweep (3)
YAKU_BILLING_FULL_PASS_SEC	Retired 26 Oct 2026: nothing reads it
YAKU_ABUSE_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between abuse-monitor checks (default 60)
YAKU_ABUSE_SOURCE	Abuse monitor reads: counters (default with Redis), records or compare
[Keeping and backing up data]
YAKU_HOT_DAYS	Days of records kept before archiving, unless a company sets its own
YAKU_HOT_MONTHS	Retired: read as days (x 30) while YAKU_HOT_DAYS is unset
YAKU_RETENTION_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between archiving passes (default 3600)
YAKU_RETENTION_SKIP_CHECKSUM	true = archive on row count alone when checksum fails
YAKU_BACKUP_ROOT	Folder for backups (default ./backups)
YAKU_BACKUP_INTERVAL_SEC	Seconds between backups (default 86400, once a day)
YAKU_BACKUP_KEEP	Complete backups kept (default 7)
[Logs, monitoring, captures]
YAKU_LOG_DIR	Folder for log files (default /var/log/yakugate)
YAKU_FX_TIMEOUT_MS	Longest one call to a currency rate provider may take, ms (3000)
YAKU_LEDGER_PER_MESSAGE	1 = still write a ledger row per message (only during an upgrade)
YAKU_RATE_HISTORY_HOURS	Hours back a message is priced by its accept-time rates (72; 0=off)
YAKU_LOSS_NO_RATE	Loss check when no exchange rate is known: refuse (default) or accept
YAKU_BASE_CURRENCY	System base currency prices are compared in (USD)
YAKU_LOG_LEVEL	Log level: debug, info, warn, error or none (info)
YAKU_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB	Start a new log file past this size, MB; 0 = none (100)
YAKU_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS	Delete log files older than this, days; 0 = keep (30)
YAKU_LOG_REDACT	Hide phone numbers and codes in logs; off = show (on)
YAKU_STATUS_PUSH_SEC	Seconds between monitoring snapshots (default 5)
YAKU_MONITOR_HISTORY	off = do not save monitoring history
YAKU_MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS	Days every 5-second report is kept; 0 = all (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_CPU_PCT	Event when host CPU goes over this % (90)
YAKU_MONITOR_EVENTS	Monitoring events on or off (on)
YAKU_MONITOR_HOLD	Intervals a condition must last to start or end an event (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_LATENCY_MS	Event when acceptance p95 goes over this, in ms (50)
YAKU_MONITOR_MEM_PCT	Event when host memory goes over this % (90)
YAKU_MONITOR_QUEUE_AGE_SEC	Event when a queue's oldest ready message waits longer (300)
YAKU_MONITOR_QUEUE_DEPTH	Event when more messages wait in one queue than this (10000)
YAKU_MONITOR_STORE_PING_MS	A MySQL or Redis round trip slower than this is a warning (100)
YAKU_MONITOR_MYSQL_CONN_PCT	MySQL connections over this % of max_connections is a warning (80)
YAKU_MONITOR_REDIS_MEM_PCT	Redis memory over this % of maxmemory is a warning (80)
YAKU_MONITOR_REPLICA_LAG_SEC	A MySQL replica further behind than this, in seconds, is a warning (30)
YAKU_MONITOR_REJECT_MIN_TPS	Refusal share judged only at this many messages/s (1)
YAKU_MONITOR_REJECT_PCT	Event when refused share of incoming goes over this % (20)
YAKU_MONITOR_SPIKE_FACTOR	Event when incoming is this many times its usual level (3)
YAKU_MONITOR_SUMMARY_DAYS	Days monitoring day summaries and events are kept (10)
YAKU_MONITOR_TRAFFIC_MIN_TPS	Traffic stop/spike judged above this messages/s (1)
YAKU_CAPTURE_MAX_RECORDS	Records the portal keeps per flow capture (20000)
YAKU_PCAP_DIR	Folder for packet captures (default <log dir>/pcap)
YAKU_PCAP_INTERFACE	Network interface tcpdump listens on (default any)
YAKU_PCAP_MAX_MB	Stop a packet capture at this size, MB; 0 = none (256)
YAKU_PCAP_TCPDUMP	tcpdump program name or full path (default tcpdump)
